interpretation: Of natural motions, those of things moved by themselves are moved by something (255b32-33). For animals, 'it is not unclear whether it is moved by something, but how one must distinguish in it the mover and the moved' (254b27-33). 'By something' may be the thing itself (part moving part), so the reading asserts only that the motion has a mover in that respect, not that the mover is another.
